name: styleseed
title_zh: 只认当前画布边界，把 StyleSeed 请求派给唯
tagline_zh: 你说「帮我弄下风格」时，它先分清你在改哪张图、哪段文，再只调对应那套 ss-* 技能——不让你在六个相似入口里瞎猜。
tagline_en: When you say "help with StyleSeed," it checks which artifact you're editing, then calls only the matching ss-*.
desc_en: Route a StyleSeed request to exactly one first workflow after resolving the current artifact boundary. Use when the user asks generally for StyleSeed help rather than invoking one specific ss-* skill.
why_zh: 别的路由靠关键词猜意图，它靠解析当前画布边界做硬判断——边界没变就锁死同一流程，变了才换，杜绝误调。
why_en: Others guess intent by keywords; this one resolves the artifact boundary first and locks the workflow until that boundary.
limit_zh: 只做路由，不执行任何风格操作。若当前画布为空或边界模糊（如同时选中多类对象），它会停下问你，不会替你选。
limit_en: Routes only, never applies styles. If canvas is empty or boundary ambiguous (multi-type selection), it stops and asks—won't guess.
title_en: Route StyleSeed to the one right workflow, by artifact.
